# ClaudeMC v1.20.2 — mixin fixes (Minecraft 1.21.11)

Fixes several `InGameHud`/`GameRenderer` mixin injection-descriptor mismatches
that crashed startup once the GLFW issue (v1.20.1) was past. These were latent:
mixin descriptors are only validated at runtime, and earlier the game crashed at
`glfwInit()` before these HUD classes ever loaded, so the mismatches were masked.

## Bug fixes (InGameHudMixin)
- `renderStatusEffectOverlay` now takes a `RenderTickCounter` (the handler still
  declared a `float`) — this was the fatal `InvalidInjectionException`.
- `renderBossBar` was renamed to `renderBossBarHud` and now takes a
  `RenderTickCounter`; the inject target and signature were updated.
- `renderScoreboardSidebar` now has two overloads; the inject targets the
  `(DrawContext, ScoreboardObjective)` overload explicitly to avoid ambiguity.

## Bug fix (GameRendererMixin)
- `getFov` now returns `float` (was `double`); the Zoom inject's
  `CallbackInfoReturnable` is parameterised with `Float` accordingly.

Verified: the client now boots through GLFW init, applies every mixin without
error, and reaches resource loading (validated with a real display via Xvfb).
